info.title: Market Lane sandbox API
info.description: INR minor units in responses. Local form session + CSRF. Seller resources are owner-scoped. Capture-only simulator; no real money. All successful API operations currently return 200. Production browser OIDC uses shared JDBC sessions; bearer requests use a separate stateless JWT chain. Stripe test mode supplies hosted checkout_url in owned payment responses; redirects never establish payment success.

price.description: Exact INR decimal, up to two fractional digits
